description: Returns a PPT Depot preview image (a slide image, template cover or collage, or free-template cover) as inline image content so it can be viewed directly. Pass any image_url, thumbnail_url, preview_images or collage_image value returned by the other tools. Only public images under pptdepot.com/images are served.

image_url.description: An image URL returned by another tool, e.g. "https://pptdepot.com/images/slides/business-case-3.gif".

name: get_image
title: Get Image
